description: Multipart framing and metadata not recorded by obj-upload-multipart: an empty and a null contentType in the metadata, a base64 Content-Transfer-Encoding media part, an empty media part, LF-only line endings, a third part and a missing closing delimiter. Checks SPEC-016.

steps.name: metadata-content-type-empty
steps.body_text:
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8

{{"name":"{object}-1","contentType":""}}
--gcsmimicdiff
Content-Type: text/plain

hello
--gcsmimicdiff--
